The '''Savarian Swoop Track''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] track that was hit by a robbery carried out by an eight-man team sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Exchange]] suffered because of the robbery, though the gang responsible was later incarcerated on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The Exchange later issued death marks for the entire gang.
